I'll look through the storefront pricing path and how special prices with dates are applied.The special is dropped in two places: the admin mapper stores the end date on the start-date field, and price calculation then checks the start date again instead of the end date. I'll fix both.Special prices that included an end date never reached the storefront as a discount. Creating a product stored the end date in the special start-date field, and the price calculation then compared the start date to today a second time instead of the end date, so the window could never match. Both now use the end date, and a special with only an end date, or with a start and an end, is applied while it is still in range.
